title: Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
abstract: arXiv:2610.37906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. translated_title: 超越低通动力学：基于共振神经元的频率选择性脉冲储备池
translated_abstract: 脉冲储备池计算结合了固定循环储备池的训练效率与事件驱动推理的能效优势，其中计算由稀疏的脉冲触发，而非在每个时间步进行密集执行。然而，现有的脉冲储备池几乎完全依赖泄漏积分发放（LIF）神经元，其低通动力学特性限制了区分不同时间频率所编码信息的能力。我们提出了HRF-Res，一种液体状态机，其中LIF神经元被谐波共振发放（HRF）神经元的异构群体所取代。这些神经元表现出内在的振荡动力学特性，并选择性地响应输入频率，使储备池能够捕获特定频率的时间模式。由此获得了比基于LIF的储备池更具判别性的表示和更高的分类精度，同时不牺牲脉冲计算的能效。
tldr: 提出HRF-Res液体状态机，用具有内在振荡特性的谐波共振发放（HRF）神经元替代LIF神经元，使脉冲储备池能够选择性响应不同输入频率，在不牺牲能效的前提下实现更具判别性的表示和更高的分类精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HRF-Res, a liquid state machine that replaces LIF neurons with Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons, enabling spiking reservoirs to selectively respond to input frequencies and achieve more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy without sacrificing energy efficiency.
